- Option B: 2027-04-12 11:00 PT / 20:00 CET / 04:00 JST (next day)
- Option C: 2027-04-13 07:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST (next day)

Attached: timezone-matrix.xlsx, demo-agenda-v2.pdf. Laura — I flagged rooms and Redwood exec availability in the sheet.

If none of the above work we can split into two shorter exec + tech blocks but I'd prefer one unified call if possible.

Thanks,
